title: reveal_cards
description: The sender reveals cards some players do not see to every player: the top cards of a deck (`quantity`, the whole deck by default) or a hand, of any player, e.g. to resolve an effect (The Perfect Gift, Artisan Academy). The log gives the cards to every player; nothing is recorded: the cards are out of sight again afterwards.

target_player_id.description: Player whose deck or hand it is.

quantity.description: Number of cards from the top of a deck; the whole stack by default.
